note: 30 candidates in this part. The session's web-search allowance was used up before this part began, and a search engine fetched directly showed a CAPTCHA (not pursued), so pages were read with the kit's own fetcher (states/net.py) from known official addresses: the State Board of Elections' 2022 general election county recaps, county and city websites, and the Court of Justice's county pages. The 2022 recaps of Anderson, Bourbon, Carter, Fleming, Garrard, Greenup, Lee, Letcher, Mercer, Pendleton and Robertson counties are scans with no text layer and were not read. Steve Riley and John Blanton are sitting legislators with record pages; the Republican Party of Kentucky's candidate page links blantonforkentucky.com (answers 404) and rileyforkentucky.com (does not resolve), so no website is recorded for either; the party listing is already in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json and is not repeated here. Lee County's elected officials page names a different coroner (not Kenneth R Lewis), so nothing is recorded for him. Kassidy Rae Dees was on the 2022 ballot as a Democrat and is on the 2026 list as a Republican; both are as the official records print them. Daniel L Alexander appears in the 2022 recap as 'Daniel ALEXANDER' for the same office (Warren County Constable, 2nd Magisterial District); county, office and name are the two anchors.
